subject: Expo staging zone accessorials & banner counts — final signoff
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@conexevents.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Revised load-in map + accessorials (action: banner counts + crate weights)

Hi Marissa / Karthik —

Attached is the venue's updated load-in map (loadin-map-v3.pdf). Two quick items we need from you to finalize dock allocations and rigging schedule: 

- Final banner count (printed hanging banners vs. vinyl floor banners) — venue needs quantities for rigging points.
- Crate manifest with weights and the number of skid-pallets for the freight windows (they're gating heavy items).
- Confirm whether you require a 30A power drop at Aisle 12 (we can provision but need the PO or cost center).

Deadline to get this to the show ops team is Friday EOD (Jul 30). Also flag if any over-height crates need an escort — they'll need measurements by Thursday.

If you want, I can loop in the freight partner (Samir) and your print vendor to coordinate shipping cutoffs.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Exhibitor Services Manager
Conex Events

Attachments: loadin-map-v3.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@conexevents.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@freightco.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised load-in map + accessorials (action: banner counts + crate weights)

Hi Olivia — thanks for the update and the map. Quick answers below and a couple of asks so we can meet your Friday deadline.

Banner / signage counts (final):
- Overhead hanging banners (rigged): 3 (two 6'x3' portrait + one 12'x2' landscape) — please reserve three rig points.
- Retractable roll-ups (floor): 4 standard 33x80"
- Backwall vinyl: 1 (10'x8') — will sit flush on booth frame, no rigging.

Crate manifest summary (full spreadsheet attached: final-ship-manifest-Redwood-2027-07-30.xlsx):
- Crate A: demo counters + monitors — 520 lbs, 1 pallet, 48" x 40" x 36"
- Crate B: printed collateral + merch — 220 lbs, 1 pallet, 48" x 40" x 30"
- Case: banner tubes (fragile) — 75 lbs, loose in crate B
- AV rack (shipper skid) — 305 lbs, 1 pallet, requires fork escort at dock.

Power: yes, we need a 30A single-phase drop at the booth corner (Aisle 12, near booth 415). Please provision and advise the cost/PO process — we'll route through marketing.

Rigging: Please confirm whether the rigging points are rated for 75 lbs each. If there are additional fees, flag them and I'll ask Karthik to approve.

Shipments: we plan to schedule a freight pickup for Aug 5 (arrive to show dock Aug 7). Samir, can you confirm the pickup slot availability and whether any additional paperwork is needed for the monitored AV crate?

Paul from PrintLab is handling the large hanging banners and roll-ups — Paul, I'm cc'ing you for lead times and final artwork approval windows.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: final-ship-manifest-Redwood-2027-07-30.xlsx

From: Paul Evans <paul.evans@printlab.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia@conexevents.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 14:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised load-in map + accessorials (action: banner counts + crate weights)

On Thu, Jul 28, 2027 at 10:05 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Paul from PrintLab is handling the large hanging banners and roll-ups — Paul, I'm cc'ing you for lead times and final artwork approval windows.

Hi team — thanks Marissa. Confirming availability and lead times:

- Hanging banners (3): production 7 business days after art approval. We require print-final PDFs by 23:59 PDT Aug 1 to hit an Aug 9 delivery. Rigging pockets and D-rings included.
- Roll-ups (4): production 3 business days after art approval; estimated delivery Aug 6 if proofs approved by Aug 2.
- Material notes: hanging banners on 13oz blockout vinyl for readability under exhibit lights.

Attached is the print quote (print-quote-PEV-2027.pdf) with line items and rush surcharge if approvals slip.

Please confirm acceptance of the quote by end of day Fri (Jul 30) and send the art files to proofs@printlab.co. If you need a small proof sample, we can overnight a color swatch for an extra fee.

Thanks,
Paul Evans
Account Manager, PrintLab Co.
paul.evans@printlab.co | 206-555-2210

Attachments: print-quote-PEV-2027.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@conexevents.com>, Paul Evans <paul.evans@printlab.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@freightco.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised load-in map + accessorials (action: banner counts + crate weights)

Thanks all — final signoff below so we can lock docks, rigging, and print timelines.

Decisions / authorizations:
- PrintLab quote approved (Paul): please proceed. Art files will be uploaded to proofs@printlab.co by Aug 1 EOD. We accept standard production timelines; no rush unless PrintLab flags a delay.
- Freight pickup: approved for Aug 5 (Samir, schedule pickup slot and confirm ETA to dock Aug 7). Please add monitored handling for AV rack.
- Rigging: approve 3 rig points; Karthik, please confirm cost center for any rigging fees (charge to Marketing-Events).
- Power: Tessa, can you book the 30A drop and email PO reference back to Olivia and Samir by Monday (Aug 2)?

Olivia — please forward any vendor-specific rigging paperwork you need us to sign.

Karthik / Tessa — quick asks:
- Karthik: confirm rigging permit cost center and reply-all.
- Tessa: book 30A drop + order floor tape for cable runs (2 rolls) and confirm by Mon Aug 2.

Thanks everyone — once Samir confirms the freight slot and Paul confirms art deadlines, I'll circulate the final vendor-ready manifest.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
